error.ARCHIVE_LIMIT: ZIP limit: 30,000 files and 2 GB extracted.
error.AUDIO_LENGTH: Use WAV up to 30 seconds at 4-96 kHz.
error.BBOX_BOUNDS: Bounding boxes must stay inside the image.
error.BEST_CHECKPOINT_MISSING: The previous best checkpoint is missing. Start a new run.
error.CLUSTERS: Cluster count must be smaller than sample count.
error.CSV_MISSING: Fill every text and label value.
error.CV_GROUPS: Too few independent sample groups in a class. Reduce the fold count.
error.DATASET_ARCHIVE: Use safe relative paths and keep extracted task data below 1 GB.
error.DATASET_BOX: Use finite positive-area boxes in x1,y1,x2,y2 format.
error.DATASET_BOX_LABEL: Object labels start at 1; 0 is background.
error.DATASET_CHANGED: Dataset content or inventory changed. Import it as a new version.
error.DATASET_CHECKSUM: Dataset source does not match the pinned checksum.
error.DATASET_FILE: Choose a ZIP with manifest.json or a labelled text CSV.
error.DATASET_FILE_SIZE: Each dataset file must be at most 30 MB.
error.DATASET_MANIFEST: Put manifest.json at the ZIP root. See the format example.
error.DATASET_NOT_READY: Import or download the dataset before training.
error.DATASET_SMALL: Each class needs at least four distinct samples for three splits.
error.DATASET_SPLIT: Provide separate train, validation and test splits, at most one million samples each.
error.DATASET_TASK: Choose a dataset compatible with the selected task.
error.DATASET_TEXT: Text is empty or exceeds the size limit.
error.DATA_LEAKAGE: Exact duplicate content crosses split boundaries. Remove it before training.
error.DEMO_TASK: Choose an image or text demo.
error.DISK_FULL: Free workspace disk space before starting. Training needs at least 1 GB.
error.DOWNLOAD_CHECKSUM: Downloaded checksum mismatch. Temporary data was removed; retry the download.
error.DOWNLOAD_RANGE: The source cannot resume this download. Try again.
error.EXPLORATION_FEATURES: Use at most 512 finite encoded features.
error.FEATUREMAP_LAYER: This model has no Conv2D layer.
error.GPU_MEMORY_BUDGET: Free VRAM is below the selected budget. Choose another GPU, lower the limit or use CPU.
error.IMAGE_LAYOUT: Use class_name/image.jpg directly inside the selected folder or ZIP.
error.KNN_NEIGHBORS: Neighbors cannot exceed training sample count.
error.MASK_CLASSES: Use grayscale indexed masks with values 0..classes-1, not RGB or 255.
error.MASK_SIZE: Mask and image dimensions must match.
error.MEMORY_BUDGET: Estimated tensors exceed the RAM budget. Reduce batch size, image size or layer dimensions.
error.NLP_REQUIRED: Open System & setup and install the NLP + GPU / CPU environment.
error.NO_CHECKPOINT: No epoch checkpoint is available to resume.
error.NO_PREDICT: DBSCAN and agglomerative assign only fitted data. Use clusters.csv.
error.PERPLEXITY: t-SNE perplexity must be smaller than sample count.
error.PREDICT_TEXT: Enter valid text in the prediction field.
error.PYTORCH_REQUIRED: Open System & setup and install PyTorch automatically.
error.REGRESSION_SAMPLES: R2 needs at least two evaluation samples.
error.RESTORE_DESTINATION_EXISTS: Choose a new directory. Existing workspaces are never overwritten.
error.RESUME_INCOMPATIBLE: Configuration, dataset or splits changed. Start a new run.
error.RESUME_VERSION: Resume with the same PyTorch version, or use exported inference/start a new run.
error.SEARCH_SPACE: Use at most five search parameters.
error.STAGING_FAILED: Cannot write execution files. Check workspace free space and permissions.
